title: Component-based software project with AI tools
summary: Students in a project-based software-engineering course create a component-based product with APIs and may add machine learning. They can use open-source and generative development tools such as ChatDev IDE and Devika while producing the software project.

sources.title: Using Generative Artificial Intelligence Tools in Software Engineering Courses
sources.evidence_quote: Students create their project component-based and use APIs to build the project ... Some of the tools they have started using are ChatDev IDE and Devika.

assessment.summary: Develop a component-based software product using APIs, with open-source and AI development tools available.
student_actions: Design and develop a component-based software product.
Use development tools, including optional AI tools.

student_role.description: Students may use ChatDev IDE, Devika, and other tools during project development.
